description: Governance, Risk, and Compliance - Integrated strategy aligning IT activities with organizational business goals and regulations.
National Institute of Standards and Technology - US government agency establishing non-regulatory cybersecurity frameworks.
Cybersecurity Framework - NIST guidance focusing on Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond, and Recover functions.
Risk Management Framework - NIST process standardizing risk management steps for federal information systems.
International Organization for Standardization - Global body developing worldwide security standards like ISO/IEC 27001.
Center for Internet Security - Non-profit entity providing benchmark security configurations and top security controls.
Cloud Security Alliance - Organization defining best practices to ensure secure cloud computing environments.
General Data Protection Regulation - Strict European Union law protecting consumer data privacy and personal data processing.
Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act - US legislation safeguarding protected health information (PHI).
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard - Information security standard for organizations processing payment cards.
Protected Health Information - Individually identifiable health information held or transmitted by a covered entity.
Personally Identifiable Information - Any data that can potentially identify a specific individual.
Sensitive Personally Identifiable Information - High-risk PII (SSNs, biometric data) requiring strict protection controls.
Sarbanes-Oxley Act - US federal law mandating strict financial reporting controls for public companies.
Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act - US federal law protecting the privacy of student education records.
Federal Information Security Modernization Act - US law requiring federal agencies to implement information security plans.
Acceptable Use Policy - Document stipulating rules and acceptable behaviors for users accessing corporate networks.
Non-Disclosure Agreement - Legal contract protecting confidential information shared between business parties.
Memorandum of Understanding - Non-binding formal agreement outlining operational intent between organizations.
Memorandum of Agreement - Legal document defining specific conditional responsibilities between parties.
Service-Level Agreement - Contractual agreement defining expected service metrics, uptime, and vendor performance.
Business Partnership Agreement - Legal agreement defining terms, profit sharing, and security responsibilities between business partners.
Request for Proposal - Document soliciting formal proposals from vendors for solutions, products, or services.
Request for Information - Formal request to gather vendor capabilities prior to initiating a procurement process.
